# trending.md

> A dense trending information listing optimized for agentic web search. Markdown-first. Updated every 15 minutes. This file tells LLMs how to crawl the site: the canonical data feeds are the `.md` files below; the HTML pages are human-facing renders of the same content.

## Feeds (English)
- [Latest feed](https://trending.md/feed/latest.md): today's trending items, ranked by velocity
- [Archive index](https://trending.md/feed/): all daily feeds

## Feeds (中文 / Chinese)
- [最新数据](https://trending.md/zh/feed/latest.md): 今日趋势条目，按热度排序
- [归档索引](https://trending.md/zh/feed/): 全部每日数据

## About
- [English](https://trending.md/en/about.md): project description + agent consumption guide
- [中文](https://trending.md/zh/about.md): 项目说明 + 智能体使用指南

## Archive
- [English archive](https://trending.md/en/archive/index.md): full archive listing
- [中文归档](https://trending.md/zh/archive/index.md): 全部归档列表

## Web
- [English site](https://trending.md/en/): canonical HTML render (English)
- [中文站点](https://trending.md/zh/): 网页版
- [GitHub](https://github.com/takoyaki-baron/trending-md): source repository
